persona.label: Primary Teacher
persona.text: Act as an experienced Scottish Primary teacher skilled in Curriculum for Excellence pedagogy.

persona.label: BGE Secondary Teacher
persona.text: Act as an experienced Scottish secondary teacher delivering Broad General Education (S1–S3).

persona.label: Nat 5 Specialist
persona.text: Act as a Qualifications Scotland National 5 specialist teacher for [insert subject].

persona.label: Higher Specialist
persona.text: Act as an experienced Scottish Higher teacher specialising in [insert subject].

persona.label: ASN Support Specialist
persona.text: Act as a supportive Scottish Support for Learning (ASN) and inclusive literacy specialist.

act.label: 50-min Lesson Plan
act.text: Create a 50-minute lesson plan on [insert topic] with clear learning intentions and success criteria

act.label: Retrieval Starter Quiz
act.text: Write an 8-question retrieval practice starter quiz on [insert topic], mixing recall and problem-solving

act.label: 3-Tier Differentiated Task
act.text: Design a 3-level differentiated classroom activity (Mild, Spicy, Extra Hot) on [insert topic]

act.label: Success Criteria Rubric
act.text: Create a student-friendly success criteria rubric for [insert assessment task]

act.label: Two Stars & a Wish
act.text: Provide encouraging Two Stars and a Wish formative feedback on [insert writing focus] without rewriting the pupil's work

recipient.label: Primary (First/Second Level)
recipient.text: for a mixed-ability [insert Primary stage, e.g. P5] class working within Curriculum for Excellence First/Second Level

recipient.label: Mixed-Ability BGE (S1–S3)
recipient.text: for a mixed-attainment [insert S1, S2, or S3] Broad General Education class

recipient.label: National 5 Candidates
recipient.text: for S4 and S5 learners preparing for Qualifications Scotland National 5 assessments

recipient.label: Higher Candidates
recipient.text: for S5 and S6 candidates working at Qualifications Scotland Higher standard

recipient.label: ASN & Dyslexia Scaffolds
recipient.text: for a mixed-ability class including chunked instructions and a 5-word glossary for learners with dyslexia or literacy barriers

theme.label: Scottish Real-World Context
theme.text: using authentic Scottish everyday contexts and £GBP currency linked to [insert real-world hook].

theme.label: Active & Inquiry-Led
theme.text: keeping the tone active, curious, and inquiry-led to spark classroom discussion.

theme.label: Exam Command Words
theme.text: aligned to Qualifications Scotland command words (Explain, Analyse, Evaluate) with clear academic precision.

theme.label: Warm Coaching Tone
theme.text: using a calm, confidence-building coaching tone that scaffolds next steps.

theme.label: DYW Career Link
theme.text: connecting the topic to Scottish workplaces and Developing the Young Workforce (DYW) skills.

structure.label: Lesson Table + Exit Pass
structure.text: Format as a clear 4-column table (Timing, Teacher Input, Pupil Activity, Support/Challenge) followed by a 3-question exit pass.

structure.label: Quiz + Marking Key
structure.text: Present as numbered pupil questions first, followed by a separate concise marking key.

structure.label: Student 'I Can...' Table
structure.text: Format as a clean 3-column pupil checklist using positive 'I can...' statements.

structure.label: Worked Example + Practice
structure.text: Begin with 1 step-by-step annotated worked example, followed by 5 graduated practice questions and answers.

structure.label: Printable Station Cards
structure.text: Organise into [insert number, e.g. 4] concise printable station cards with pupil instructions and hinge questions.
